objective: Make the post-support transition to Rider x Circumference predictive testing immediate while preventing any result-driven choice of formula, shrinkage, missingness, membership, metric, bootstrap or advancement rule.

baseline_evidence_only_not_promotion.interpretation: S0 is a credible fixed baseline for challenger testing. This development confirmation is not untouched final validation and does not establish profitability or production readiness.
